Michelangelo's Sistine Chapel ceiling is shown to the public.
KDKA makes the first commercial radio broadcast.
Mariner 10 launches toward Venus and Mercury.
Howard Carter finds the steps to Tutankhamun's tomb.
The Gunpowder Plot to blow up Parliament is foiled.
Abraham Lincoln is elected US president.
Marie Curie is born in Warsaw.
Wilhelm Rontgen discovers X-rays.
The Berlin Wall falls.
Sesame Street premieres.
The Armistice ends fighting in the First World War.
Voyager 1 flies past Saturn.
Mariner 9 becomes the first spacecraft to orbit Mars.
Nellie Bly sets off to travel around the world in under 80 days.
Intel announces the 4004, the first commercial microprocessor.
UNESCO is founded.
The Suez Canal opens.
Mickey Mouse appears in Steamboat Willie.
Lincoln delivers the Gettysburg Address.
Microsoft releases Windows 1.0.
Two men make the first crewed hot-air balloon flight in Paris.
Toy Story, the first fully computer-animated film, is released.
Doctor Who premieres on the BBC.
Darwin publishes On the Origin of Species.
The Mousetrap opens in London; it is still running.
NASA launches the Curiosity rover to Mars.
Alfred Nobel signs his will, creating the Nobel Prizes.
Mariner 4 launches toward Mars.
Atari releases the arcade game Pong.
Scotland and England play the first international football match.
